pinnedBy: Manual smoke-test run via check-primitives.js + rubric application during SOTA architecture fix session. See aicodepath-docs/harness-eval/20260408T173355Z-full-smoke.md for the full rendered report that produced these verdicts.

1.rationale: agent-loader.js + agent-registry.js + parseFrontmatter across agent-wiring-check.js and stats-builder.js. 106 agent markdown files + 102 SKILL.md files enumerable statically without LLM.

2.rationale: permission-manager.js:77 CHECK(decision IN (allow, deny, ask)) — 3-tier enum matches CC bar exactly. safety-guardrails.js R01-R06 provides additional classifier layer.

3.rationale: checkpoint-manager.js (file-based snapshots) + enhanced-checkpoint-manager.js (file + conversation rollback) + session-state-manager.js. Resume via /aicodepath-resume skill.

4.rationale: phase-state-machine.js (6 phases × 7 gate types with transitionHistory). workflow_state table has UNIQUE(phase, stage, COALESCE(cr_number, N/A)) — qualifies as unique-constraint idempotency form per rubric. Matches CC pattern (CC also lacks explicit idempotency keys).

5.rationale: pricing-calculator.js predictBudget + checkBudget + classifyTaskComplexity (5 tiers). cost-tracker-hook.js persists per-session via Stop event. Same post-completion gating pattern as CC (neither system does literal pre-turn).

6.rationale: event-publisher.js + ws-emitter.js + websocket-server.js + api/server.js. Dashboard + terminal WebSocket channels. ~20 emit methods with safe-fail try/catch.

7.rationale: lib/logger.js (structured, Winston) + decision-logger.js (ADRs to decisions table + audit_log view) + agent-trace-logger.js (JSONL with 14 operation types). logger.info/error calls throughout api/routes/.

8.rationale: confidence-checker.js (5 weighted checks, thresholds 90/70) + guideline-validator.js + /aicodepath-verify skill + /aicodepath-edd skill (EDD) + GICL score loop + TDD enforcement. Best-in-class implementation.

9.rationale: agent-suggester.js DOMAIN_MAPPING (209 entries verified) + VIOLATION_TYPE_MAPPING (23 entries). swarm-team-composer.js composeTeam() with PHASE_DEFAULTS per AIDLC phase. /aicodepath-classify-component skill for per-feature agent recommendations.

10.rationale: pre-compact-hook.js integrates with CC PreCompact event — creates auto-checkpoint before compaction, returns preserve_messages (first message + last 5), emits WS event, prompts /aicodepath-learn. Host integration pattern is preferred over reimplementation per rubric.

11.rationale: EXCEEDS Claude Code baseline. hooks/lib/permission-manager.js:91 CREATE TABLE permission_audit with action CHECK IN (grant, revoke, use, suggest). Line 94 enum, lines 148/192/220 auditLog() calls on grant/use/revoke, line 354 SELECT for audit queries, line 396 INSERT. Dedicated aicodepath-docs/permissions.db file separate from main DB. CLI interface: grant/check/list/suggestions/stats/audit/cleanup. CC reference is in-memory only — aicodepath-tool has full persistent SQL ledger.

12a.rationale: /aicodepath-diagnostics skill + database-health.js (network FS detection, WAL/DELETE journal mode auto-select, retry-on-busy) + diagnostics.sh + validate-structure.sh + mcp-health-check.js hook. Multiple diagnostic entry points.

12b.rationale: bin/aicodepath.js init + commands/init.js + pre-flight-check.js + preference-bootstrap.js exist. Init IS staged (DB → migrations → symlinks → settings.json → MCP). Gap: no formal staged-boot abstraction with typed stage reporting or per-session readiness result that other hooks can depend on before proceeding. Implicit stages, not explicit.

12c.rationale: stop_reason field present in multiple subsystems: gicl-session-manager.js:57 (TEXT column with 4+ values — superseded, quality_gate_passed, max_iterations_reached, stale_auto_closed), session-auto-cleanup.js:49 (stale_auto_closed_session_start), hook-wrapper.js:99 (propagates stopReason from hook results), gicl-iteration-hook.js:362-367 (custom stop conditions). Matches CC bar: free-text reason field in multiple subsystems.

12d.rationale: reflexion-learner.js (session_id + confidence 0-1 monotonic + times_used + times_helped + created_at + resolved_at) + visual-memory-writer.js (diagram staleness detection) + aicodepath-learn 11-field preference schema with source_note + expires_when + enabled gate. preference-roundtrip.test.js verifies round-trip of all provenance fields.

invariants.description: Primitive 11 (Permission Audit Trail) must remain EXCEEDS — aicodepath-tool's persistent SQL audit ledger in permission-manager.js:91 is the canonical proof that the framework exceeds Claude Code's in-memory denialTracking.ts baseline. Downgrading this verdict would mean the permission_audit table was deleted or stopped being used.
invariants.failureMessage: Primitive #11 dropped below EXCEEDS. Check hooks/lib/permission-manager.js:91 for the permission_audit CREATE TABLE — if missing, investigate why the persistent ledger was removed.

invariants.description: No primitive should ever verdict MISSING. The 2026-04-08 baseline has zero MISSING primitives and any regression to MISSING represents either (a) functionality being deleted or (b) a check script bug that needs fixing before the drift is accepted.
invariants.failureMessage: At least one primitive verdicted MISSING. Every MISSING must be investigated before the baseline is re-pinned — do not silently accept.

invariants.description: Day One primitives (1-8) are the non-negotiable minimum for any production agent harness per Nate B. Jones' framework. Any primitive in this range dropping below PASS is a catastrophic regression.
invariants.failureMessage: A Day One primitive (1-8) verdicted MISSING. This is catastrophic. Do not re-pin until the underlying cause is fixed.

invariants.description: The rubric covers exactly 12 primitives. If the skill produces a different total, either the rubric was extended without updating the fixture, or the check scripts are dropping primitives on the floor.
invariants.failureMessage: Total primitive count != 12. Investigate check-primitives.js CHECKS array or the rubric file.
